title: Nearby Sacred Temples — 51 Shakti Peethas
description: For each of the 51 Shakti Peethas, nearby sacred temples that exist. Researched from official temple sites, Incredible India, state tourism departments, Wikipedia, and pilgrimage guides. Covers Shakti Peethas across India, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Nepal, and Sri Lanka.
